jobs.title: AI Engineering - Assoc Software Engineer Internships - Summer 2027 (Bachelors)
jobs.description: It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. As a full stack Associate Software Development Engineer Intern , you'll partner with senior level engineers to help design, build, and maintain software across the application stack from user-facing interfaces to APIs, data stores, and cloud infrastructure. You'll write well-tested, maintainable code, take part in code reviews, and use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while critically evaluating AI-generated output for correctness and security. You’ll also collaborate with product managers, designers, and peer engineers is essential to create resilient, scalable solutions. What you do Full Software Development Lifecycle Build features end-to-end, with guidance from your team, from design through deployment—across front-end (React/Angular/Vue) and back-end (REST/GraphQL, microservices) solutions System Design & Architecture Contribute to system design discussions: learn how the team evaluates architectural trade-offs and help define data models, API contracts, and cloud-native and persistence approaches for your project Code Quality Testing and Review Write comprehensive tests, follow coding standards, and review code—including AI-generated code—for security, performance, and maintainability. Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites to validate software functionality, catch defects early, CI/CD, DevOps & Operational Readiness Use and help maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure- as-code, learn to monitor systems in production, and support incident response, including for AI-integrated components Cross Functional Collaboration & Technical Communication Partner with product managers, designers, and platform teams to scope and deliver features, document your work clearly, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. We hire in multiple other locations including, but not limited to: Santa Clara, CA, San Diego, CA, Kirkland, WA, West Palm Beach, FL and other geographical areas. Work location will be determined based on team growth strategies. Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or related field; with a graduation date no earlier than May 2028 Must be available to work full-time hours, for a 12-week period, either May – August or June – September in 2027 Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. Full-stack development skills: Exposure through coursework, personal projects, internships, or hackathons to front-end frameworks (React/Angular/Vue), back-end languages (Node.js, Python, Java, Go), databases, REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), plus comfort adopting emerging AI/ML tools. Preferred Qualifications: Foundational systems thinking: Exposure to software architecture concepts, API design, databases, or distributed systems through coursework or projects Software engineering fundamentals: Familiar with writing clean, secure, well-tested code, along with understanding of how to treat code review as a quality practice. AI fluency : Exposure to AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, etc) and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight models) to build features, and understanding the need for sound judgment when reviewing AI-generated code for correctness and security. Technical communication: Ability to break down requirements into actionable tasks and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. We know great candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If you’re excited about this opportunity and meet the minimum qualifications, we encourage you to apply. For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $55.56/hour , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. jobs.description:
The Opportunity At Adobe, our mission is to empower creatives, marketers, and IT professionals with application-based products that transform their daily work and accelerate progress towards their business goals. Our Technical Pre-Sales (TPS) organization plays a critical role in preparing customers to purchase Adobe’s integrated solutions by understanding their business needs, defining and validating their technical requirements, and demonstrating their ideal future state with Adobe technology. The Enterprise Architecture (EA) team is within the TPS group. This role will be supporting the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team within TPS. Learn More about Enterprise Architecture Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team sits within the TPS organization and works directly with Adobe customers to understand their current technology architecture and usage, evaluate its effectiveness as it relates to their larger business objectives, and create a future-state technology architecture to best support their long-term marketing vision. You will learn how the team runs, how they interact with customers, real-world customer problems mapped to Adobe software solutions, and what key results they are responsible for building all while supporting and influencing the growing team’s operational strategy. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. jobs.title: Data Engineer (L5) – AWS GND, PAX Data and Analytcis
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building data infrastructure that powers real business processes and impacts investments at scale? We're looking for an experienced AI-Driven Data Engineer to design, build, and scale the data foundations — grounded in business context — that power Large Language Models (LLMs), analytics, and autonomous agentic workflows. In this role, you'll bridge the gap by collecting data from multiple sources and building high-quality pipelines that convert business processes into context, establishing a reusable data model. You'll set up appropriate quality controls and monitor and optimize pipeline throughput to deliver highly available, scalable data pipelines. You'll work across the full data lifecycle — from ingestion and transformation to modeling and delivery — partnering with software engineers to ensure the right business entities flow through our systems and are translated into data that scientists, BI engineers, and analysts can use for in-depth analysis and metric development. Beyond solving complex data challenges, this role offers the opportunity to own significant portions of our data architecture, drive improvements to data quality and governance, and directly influence how your team and its customers make data-driven decisions. You'll be at the center of realizing the impact of your work — delivering on the goals of the Global Data Center Capacity Delivery Team. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and data infrastructure, applying strong SQL and AWS tools like Glue, S3, Spark , Athena etc to extract, transform, and load data at scale. - AI/RAG Data Architecture: Build and optimize data models, vector schemas, and feature stores designed for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and analytical workloads. - Data Quality & Observability: Implement automated data validation, freshness/anomaly monitoring, lineage tracking, and alerting tailored for downstream AI consumption. - Optimize data storage and query performance through partitioning, indexing, and resource-efficient design across databases and distributed systems. - Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and engineering peers to gather requirements, prioritize work, and deliver curated datasets and self-service data products that provide clear business value. - Improve data processes by automating manual operations, implementing data quality and lineage tracking, and contributing to code reviews, design discussions, and engineering best practices. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing pipeline health and data quality metrics, then shift into building or refining data models that support your team's analytical needs. You might pair with a data scientist to design a data pipeline AI workflow, create and lead a design review to evaluate a new pipeline architecture, or mentor a teammate on data modeling best practices. You will regularly evaluate opportunities to leverage generative AI tools to augment your productivity and streamline repetitive tasks and pipelines About the team Our team is focused on delivering reliable, well-governed, data infrastructure that enables informed decision-making across the organization. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a commitment to making data accessible and trustworthy for our customers. As we look ahead, we are investing in modern data practices and scalable solutions that will grow with Global AWS evolving needs. If you are excited about building data systems that matter and growing your career alongside a supportive, inclusive team, we would love to hear from you. - 3+ years of data engineering experience - 3+ years of data modeling experience - 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience - Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines - Experience with SQL - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS - Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions - Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases) - Knowledge of batch and streaming data architectures like Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Storm, Beam Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Formal Verification Engineer - New College Grad 2026
jobs.description: As a Formal Verification Engineer at NVIDIA, you will work in the formal verification team for the industry's leading chips. We are looking for outstanding candidates with knowledge of formal methods. The engineer will own the task of formal verification of RTL units for next generation chip designs. This will involve the candidate having deep knowledge of architectural as well as micro-architectural details of the unit. Ideal candidate must have strong analytical skills, computer architecture background and as well as experience in application of effective verification methodology. What you will be doing: Developing comprehensive FV testplan documents. Identifying key behaviors for verification of DUT and creating a verification plan. Developing verification environment including environment assumptions, assertions and cover properties in context of the verification plan. Applying various FV techniques to proof correctness of digital designs. Debugging RTL to identify failure scenarios. Developing scripts to automate the verification process. Review formal setups and proofs with design and verification teams. What we need to see: BS, MS, or Ph.D. in CS/CE/EE/Mathematics or equivalent experience. Strong analytical skills to solve difficult problems. Knowledge/Experience in formal verification techniques. Strong knowledge of architectures of CPU/GPU designs and digital logic. Understanding of abstraction techniques for effective verification. Hands-on experience with HDLs such as Verilog / System Verilog. Ability to understand RTL quickly. Understanding of temporal logic assertions. Preferable experience with Formal Verification Tools (eg . Jasper, IFV, SMV, SPIN) Excellent communication skills with ability to work with team members and collaborate effectively. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love the challenge of crafting the highest performance & lowest power silicon possible? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our Formal Verification team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 116,000 USD - 189,750 USD for Level 2, and 136,000 USD - 218,500 USD for Level 3. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 17, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Agentic Data Engineer, Frontier AI Tooling
jobs.description: Do you want to build the products that help AWS ProServe and Frontier AI teams understand customer needs, develop the right solutions, and deliver them at scale? We are looking for a Data Engineer to own the data foundations behind the products and experiences that span ProServe, Frontier AI, and services teams within AWS Sales, Marketing and Global Sales. Your pipelines and datasets will let these teams deeply understand customer challenges, rapidly develop tailored solutions, and orchestrate delivery, directly accelerating how AWS delivers business outcomes to our customers. You will build and operate the pipelines and datasets that feed the context layer and agentic workflows: ingesting external insights, internal data, and insights collected by sales and delivery teams, and turning them into reliable, well-modeled datasets that models and agents can reason over. You design data models, ETL, and integration services that are flexible, extensible, and scalable, then support and grow them over time. This is a hands-on role where the playbook is written in real time. You ship to production and own the correctness of the data that downstream agents depend on. You are comfortable with ambiguity and partner with business leaders to build the pipelines that answer their key questions. You will unify fragmented data pipelines, build robust data models, and ensure reliable data lineage across multiple product areas, working closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and high opportunity for impact.
